sentences.en: The wretched boat bobbed up and down on the rough sea.
sentences.zh: 那艘破旧的船在汹涌的海面上一起一伏。

sentences.en: They salvaged what they could from the sunken wretched boat.
sentences.zh: 他们从沉没的破船上打捞了一些有用的物品。

sentences.en: The wretched boat was a reminder of the stormy past for the old fisherman.
sentences.zh: 那艘破旧的船让老渔夫想起了过去的风风雨雨。
